نستئب (form X)
# نَسْتَئِبُّ (nastaʔibbu) /nas.ta.ʔib.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأَبَّ (istaʔabba)
# نَسْتَئِبَّ (nastaʔibba) /nas.ta.ʔib.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأَبَّ (istaʔabba)
# نَسْتَئِبِّ (nastaʔibbi) /nas.ta.ʔib.bi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَأَبَّ (istaʔabba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
